description: Led UI/UX design for Flowbit, creating user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes using Figma and Stitch. Served as Team Captain, coordinating the UI/UX team, refining workflows, and ensuring consistent progress across design iterations.

Developed AI Study Buddy, a PDF-based AI learning assistant with interactive chat, study modes, and Explainer, Summarizer, and Quizzer features. Integrated Google Gemini and Bytez APIs with model selection, API key management, chat history, and session management.
Engineered responsive web applications including a Photo Gallery, Music Player, and Calculator using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, prioritizing clean UI and cross-device usability.
